description: Florian Kotthoff publishes a TwinEU transformation of selected German Marktstammdatenregister generating units into Common Information Model terms. Zenodo offers three technology CSVs, for wind, biomass and hydro, plus metadata JSON under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The source register is maintained by Germany’s Bundesnetzagentur and is much larger than this snapshot. This mapped subset can help prepare generator inventories for CIM-compatible electricity-network simulation. The related catalogue record covers the live MaStR register; this separate Zenodo resource adds a specific open semantic mapping and fixed file release. A limitation is that the first version covers only named technologies and selected attributes, not every power or gas unit in MaStR. The original register states Datenlizenz Deutschland attribution 2.0, so users should retain source attribution as well as the Zenodo terms. The CSVs were not downloaded and mapping fidelity was not tested.
